title: Acuity Brands Deep-Dive Analysis
summary: Acuity combines cyclical lighting and longer-run controls growth.
coverage_note: All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

claims.claim: Macro improvement is not yet decisive
claims.reason: The statement deliberately withholds a directional forecast. A hindsight score would misrepresent uncertainty as prediction.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

claims.claim: Tariffs may create a false rebound
claims.reason: December/January is a genuine window. Later COVID losses cannot establish that tariff front-loading caused a near-term false signal.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.
claims.next_check: Use vintage monthly trade, inventories and production data through January, before the pandemic shutdown.

claims.claim: Rising claims would signal unemployment bottom
claims.reason: This is a conditional diagnostic without a numerical persistence rule. Initial claims can rise briefly without unemployment turning.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.
claims.next_check: Specify weeks, smoothing and false-positive criterion, then test on unrevised claims.

claims.claim: Cheap high-ROIC companies offer attractive returns
claims.reason: A systematic factor test requires precise screening and portfolio definitions. One selected stock cannot validate the strategy.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

claims.claim: Acuity has a decade-long smart-building runway
claims.reason: The ten-year runway extends beyond the evaluation date. Early cyclical weakness does not refute a controls business opportunity, but that opportunity must translate into returns on incremental capital.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.
claims.next_check: At the endpoint compare organic controls revenue, margins and incremental returns with the 2019 base.

claims.claim: Base model yields ten-percent annual returns
claims.conditions: EPS grows 6% then 12%; specified payout and valuation
claims.reason: The stated ten-year endpoint is November 2029. Model arithmetic is not a realized result; interim earnings declines also show that a smooth trajectory should not be assumed.
claims.timing_assessment: Original horizon retained: next decade (to November 2029)
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: 2020 annual report financials
evidence.finding: FY 2020 sales fell 9%, operating profit 24% and EPS 24%; operating cash flow rose 2%, cash exceeded debt, and free cash flow remained positive.

claims.next_check: Calculate reinvested total return at the original endpoint and separately audit each model assumption.

claims.claim: IoT enthusiasm inflated the old valuation
claims.reason: A declining multiple is consistent with excessive expectations but does not identify IoT enthusiasm as the cause. Need contemporary forecasts, orders and multiple decomposition.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.
claims.next_check: Compare 2015-19 earnings revisions and valuation changes against contemporaneous IoT expectations.

claims.claim: Construction cycles constrain extrapolated earnings growth
claims.reason: The 2020 operating-profit decline was much larger than the sales decline, consistent with operating leverage. It does not isolate ordinary construction cyclicality from pandemic disruption.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: 2020 annual report financials
evidence.finding: FY 2020 sales fell 9%, operating profit 24% and EPS 24%; operating cash flow rose 2%, cash exceeded debt, and free cash flow remained positive.

claims.reason: A severe 2020 contraction left Acuity profitable, cash-generative and net-cash positive. This directly supports the limited resilience claim, not immunity from share-price losses.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Cash buffers and positive operating cash flow supplied funding capacity.

evidence.title: 2020 annual report financials
evidence.finding: FY 2020 sales fell 9%, operating profit 24% and EPS 24%; operating cash flow rose 2%, cash exceeded debt, and free cash flow remained positive.

claims.claim: Bear model still earns seven percent
claims.reason: This is a conditional ten-year model, not a forecast that its specified path must occur. The ending valuation and dividend-reinvested return remain unobserved.
claims.timing_assessment: Original horizon retained: next decade (to November 2029)
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.
claims.next_check: At 2029 compare realized earnings, terminal multiple and total return with model assumptions.

claims.claim: A broad correction can reduce Acuity twenty percent
claims.reason: Acuity fell from a $127.31 closing baseline on November 22, 2019 to $71.08 on March 23, 2020, a 44.17% drop. The broad-equity correction condition occurred. This verifies the warned capacity for a loss exceeding 20%, not the claim that the decline came solely from sentiment or that a warning was a short recommendation.
claims.direction_assessment: See independently checked outcomes and qualifications in reason.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: AYI daily price observations
evidence.finding: November 22, 2019 close $127.31; March 23, 2020 close $71.08, down 44.17%. Historical OHLC is split-normalized by the vendor, not a record of executed trades; prices exclude distributions.

claims.claim: Tax reversal can reduce domestic profits
claims.reason: The general scenario needs a specified tax change and taxable-profit exposure. It should not be scored as a forecast of enactment.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

claims.claim: Foreign sales do not diversify legal domicile
claims.reason: Revenue geography and corporate legal domicile are distinct attributes. Subsequent Russian restrictions illustrate why instrument domicile and custody can dominate where sales occur. This is a structural distinction, not a return forecast.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: On depositary receipt facilities of PJSC LUKOIL
evidence.finding: Russian law prohibited offshore depositary-receipt circulation. Lukoil announced ADR program termination effective December 30, 2022 and London listing cancellation June 6, with conversion arrangements for eligible holders.

claims.claim: Mexico production mitigates China tariff exposure
claims.reason: This requires the actual production and sourcing mix plus tariff pass-through, not merely a Mexico factory presence.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.
claims.next_check: Reconcile imported components, country-of-origin rules, tariffs paid and pricing changes in FY 2020 filings.

claims.claim: Tariffs can enhance Acuity pricing power
claims.reason: FY 2020 gross margin improved, but cost changes, mix and controls sales can also explain that. No causal tariff effect has been isolated.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: 2020 annual report financials

claims.next_check: Read management price/cost bridge and compare exposed competitors.

framework_lessons: Stress cash flow separately from price.
assessment: The balance-sheet resilience argument survived its first severe stress. The ten-year return models are genuinely unresolved, while tariff and construction causal claims require more than the pandemic outcome. The review does not assign a stock-selection win from profitable operations alone.
verification_limitations: Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.
No complete adjusted total-return series or original-vintage macro database was available for this review. Unverified outcomes are explicitly unscored.
